method: Built-in image generation, precise-object-edit. Empty background plate; approved foreground paint preserved in independently clipped SVG components.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: hidden clean background plate for layered motion animation of this exact approved CAISIK 1536x1024 illustrated artwork. Input image is the EDIT TARGET, not a style inspiration.
PRIMARY REQUEST: remove ALL foreground hero illustration elements while preserving the exact dark gothic urban architectural environment. The end result must be an EMPTY architectural background behind those foreground objects, in the identical framing, perspective, saturated yellow/gold, charcoal black and sharp black comic ink style.
REMOVE completely: the entire large TRANSMUTE graffiti word and every gold drip, CAISIK handstyle, central seated hooded alchemist/man/clothing/shoes/beads/pendant, the giant circular snake ouroboros, every gold halo/geometric line/triangle/orbit/sphere floating in front, the sun face and rays, the crescent moon and stars disc, the microphone and vinyl record, every red ribbon and red smoke flourish, the lower center flower/compass and dangling diamond. Do not retain ghosts, silhouettes or outlines of removed foreground objects.
PRESERVE: gothic arch canopy, black stone pillars and side hooded stone statues, deep vertical city skyscrapers on left/right with sparse yellow lit windows, angular cracked stone plinth blocks under the former seated figure and word, the wet black cobbled floor at bottom with controlled gold reflected light. Reconstruct plausible dark continuous architecture and cracked stone plinths where the removed objects were. It is fine and desirable for the central area to be very dark; the original painted foreground will be composited on top. Keep floor reflections understated without letter-shaped reflections. No new symbols, text, people or additional foreground ornament.
CONSTRAINTS: same landscape 1536x1024 framing/composition. Keep exact original architectural edges and dark premium graphic novel style. Sharp clean ink work, no blur, no haze, no sepia fading, no photorealism, no new text. Opaque background, no transparency. This is an animation production cleanplate, NOT a redesign of the original artwork.
